notes:
Lead came in via self-serve signup and quickstart on 2026-02-20. Small ecommerce platform (11-50 employees) doing cart recovery + chat support bots. Early discovery — wants hosted API but needs tight guidance on rate limits and burst handling. Key pain: periodic marketing flash sales that drive sudden traffic spikes for short windows (10-30s bursts). During our internal quick load test they hit consistent 429s once concurrency reached ~120 req/s; they called this out as a blocker for go-live. Wants predictable behavior: clear X-RateLimit-* headers, burst allowance, and a way to request temporary quota increases for campaigns. "We need to avoid cart abandonment during spikes — 429s kill UX," said CTO (paraphrase).
